summary: TAP Real Estate Technologies filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a September 9 Subscription Agreement with Alpenhaus Resort, LLC, under which TAP transferred its Wasatch Springs option on the Zermatt Resort in Midway, Utah, to Alpenhaus in exchange for a 2% membership interest; Alpenhaus simultaneously closed the Zermatt purchase. TAP also signed a Technology Services Agreement: a $60,000 upfront platform fee plus $6,000 monthly, one-year initial term auto-renewing unless 90 days' notice, exclusive tokenization rights. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or premium was disclosed. Watch execution and tokenization follow-through.
